the use of the contraceptive pill is a good option to avoid pregnancy.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the prevalence of preconception health behaviors is low in Brazil.
the preconception period is a critical time to intervene to promote health behaviors that may improve maternal and child health outcomes.
a woman’s preconception health status is an important determinant of pregnancy outcomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should be more concerned about the health of women who are trying to get pregnant than those who are already pregnant.

we need to better understand the role of social networks, social support, and social capital in the lives of pregnant and postpartum women and how these factors may influence the health of mothers and infants.
